mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals an impending economic slowdown that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate a weakening consumer demand amid price pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS declines and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) and rising capacity utilization, the risk of a supply shock increases, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) above 1,800,000 units per month indicate robust consumer demand and a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 1,800,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% annually, it triggers a shift toward monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a policy response to an economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market peak (HOUST above 1,800,000 units), rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a strong consumer sector that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1,800,000 units and RSAFS is rising.
